title: Poland Residence Permit Wait Times: Official Voivodeship Office Data
description: Official residence-permit processing times (average days to decision, not medians), application counts and pending cases from 11 of 16 Polish voivodeship offices, for 2025 and 1 Jan to 30 Sep 2026. Expat Essentials Poland obtained the figures through public-information requests sent on 2026-10-07; every row cites the office letter reference. Methods differ between offices (see README). Tracker: expatessentials.pl/karta-pobytu-waiting-times-tracker. Publisher: expatessentials.pl.
